risks.title: Dependency on UniCredit and governance risk
risks.score_rationale: Major risk identified at the beginning of Item 1A. Intensive language on compliance with parent company directives and discretionary authority. FinecoBank is controlled by UniCredit with an obligation to comply with group directives. Trend stable but structural. High weight for a listed subsidiary.

risks.title: Risk of conflicts of interest with parent company UniCredit
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned under Art. 136 TUB concerning transactions with executives and the parent company. Precise legal language indicating a major regulatory concern. Trend stable but structural risk inherent in intra-group relationships. Critical litigation/compliance category.

risks.title: Insider information management and market abuse risk
risks.score_rationale: Section 5 entirely dedicated to insider information management procedures. Detailed and normative language indicating a major regulatory concern. Trend stable but growing complexity due to dual status (listed subsidiary plus controlled). High weight for CONSOB/Borsa Italiana compliance.

risks.title: Risk of concentrated executive power with the Amministratore Delegato
risks.score_rationale: Alessandro Foti combines the roles of Amministratore Delegato and Direttore Generale since July 2014. Neutral language but concentrated governance structure. Trend stable. Moderate weight but succession risk and personal dependency.

risks.title: Risk of complex banking regulatory compliance
risks.score_rationale: Multiple references to TUB, TUF, Banca d'Italia Circular n. 285, Codice di Autodisciplina, Regolamento Emittenti. Intensive technical and normative language. Trend stable but evolving regulatory framework. Very high weight for a banca.

risks.title: Risk of information technology systems failure and cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: Implicit in the management of insider information registries and information flows. Moderate language but critical infrastructure for a digital bank. Trend up (increasing risk). Moderate weight but high potential impact.

risks.title: Risk of intense competition in the digital banking sector
risks.score_rationale: Not explicitly detailed in the excerpt but implicit in the fintech banca model. Absent language but highly competitive market context. Trend up (increasing pressure). Moderate weight for a specialized subsidiary.

risks.title: Risk of technology dependency and obsolescence
risks.score_rationale: Implicit in the digital bank model. Absent language but critical to business model. Trend up (rapid technological evolution). Moderate weight but strategic risk.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence, machine learning or related technologies in the assembly documents provided. FinecoBank does not communicate an AI strategy at this stage of its development in 2014-2015.
evidence: No reference to AI, machine learning or advanced automation in the ordinary and extraordinary assembly documents
Positioning focused on traditional digital banking, asset management services and investment services
Absence of KPIs or technology initiatives related to software innovation or AI adoption in the documentation
